//This c++ code is generated by PictoBlox
// GrowthOracle v2 - Stunting & Underweight Detection
// Hardware : Arduino Uno + HX711_ADC + HC-SR04 + LCD 16x2 I2C
// Data     : WHO Child Growth Standards (verified PDF)
// Commands : AGE:xx | GEN:M/F | TARE | MEASURE | STATUS

#include <HX711_ADC.h>
#include <Wire.h>
#include <LiquidCrystal_I2C.h>
#include <EEPROM.h>

// ── HX711
const int HX711_dout = 4;
const int HX711_sck  = 5;
HX711_ADC LoadCell(HX711_dout, HX711_sck);

// ── ULTRASONIC
#define TRIG_PIN     8
#define ECHO_PIN     9
#define MAX_HEIGHT   100.0

// ── LCD (change 0x27 to 0x3F if blank)
LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x27, 16, 2);

// ── CALIBRATION
float calibrationValue = 22.55;

// ── WHO DATA PROGMEM (verified WHO PDF)
const float PROGMEM BOYS_H2SD[25]  = {46.1,50.8,54.4,57.3,59.7,61.7,63.3,64.8,66.2,67.5,68.7,69.9,71.0,72.1,73.1,74.1,75.0,76.0,76.9,77.7,78.6,79.4,80.2,81.0,81.7};
const float PROGMEM BOYS_H3SD[25]  = {44.2,48.9,52.4,55.3,57.6,59.6,61.2,62.7,64.0,65.2,66.4,67.6,68.6,69.6,70.6,71.6,72.5,73.3,74.2,75.0,75.8,76.5,77.2,78.0,78.7};
const float PROGMEM GIRLS_H2SD[25] = {45.4,49.8,53.0,55.6,57.8,59.6,61.2,62.7,64.0,65.3,66.5,67.7,68.9,70.0,71.0,72.0,73.0,74.0,74.9,75.8,76.7,77.5,78.4,79.2,80.0};
const float PROGMEM GIRLS_H3SD[25] = {43.6,47.8,51.0,53.5,55.6,57.4,58.9,60.3,61.7,62.9,64.1,65.2,66.3,67.3,68.3,69.3,70.2,71.1,72.0,72.8,73.7,74.5,75.2,76.0,76.7};
const float PROGMEM BOYS_W2SD[25]  = {2.5,3.4,4.3,5.0,5.6,6.0,6.4,6.7,6.9,7.1,7.4,7.6,7.7,7.9,8.1,8.3,8.4,8.6,8.8,8.9,9.1,9.2,9.4,9.5,9.7};
const float PROGMEM BOYS_W3SD[25]  = {2.1,2.9,3.8,4.4,4.9,5.3,5.7,5.9,6.2,6.4,6.6,6.8,6.9,7.1,7.2,7.4,7.5,7.7,7.8,8.0,8.1,8.2,8.4,8.5,8.6};
const float PROGMEM GIRLS_W2SD[25] = {2.4,3.2,3.9,4.5,5.0,5.4,5.7,6.0,6.3,6.5,6.7,6.9,7.0,7.2,7.4,7.6,7.7,7.9,8.1,8.2,8.4,8.6,8.7,8.9,9.0};
const float PROGMEM GIRLS_W3SD[25] = {2.0,2.7,3.4,4.0,4.4,4.8,5.1,5.3,5.6,5.8,5.9,6.1,6.3,6.4,6.6,6.7,6.9,7.0,7.2,7.3,7.5,7.6,7.8,7.9,8.1};

// ── STATE
int    ageMonths  = -1;
char   gender     = '?';
float  weightKg   = 0.0;
float  heightCm   = 0.0;
bool   doClassify = false;
String serialBuf  = "";

float getRef(const float* arr, int idx) {
  return pgm_read_float(&arr[idx]);
}

int calcRiskScore(float h, float h2SD, float h3SD) {
  if (h >= h2SD) return 0;
  if (h <= h3SD) return 100;
  return (int)(40.0 + ((h2SD - h) / (h2SD - h3SD)) * 60.0);
}

float measureHeight() {
  float total = 0; int valid = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    digitalWrite(TRIG_PIN, LOW);  delayMicroseconds(2);
    digitalWrite(TRIG_PIN, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(10);
    digitalWrite(TRIG_PIN, LOW);
    long dur = pulseIn(ECHO_PIN, HIGH, 30000);
    if (dur > 0) {
      float dist = dur * 0.034 / 2.0;
      float h = MAX_HEIGHT - dist;
      if (h > 10.0 && h <= MAX_HEIGHT) { total += h; valid++; }
    }
    delay(50);
  }
  return (valid > 0) ? (total / valid) : 0.0;
}

void parseSerial(String cmd) {
  cmd.trim();
  if (cmd.startsWith("AGE:")) {
    int val = cmd.substring(4).toInt();
    if (val >= 0 && val <= 24) {
      ageMonths = val;
      lcd.clear();
      lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("Age set:");
      lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print(String(ageMonths) + " months");
      Serial.println("ACK:AGE:" + String(ageMonths));
      delay(1500);
    } else { Serial.println("ERR:AGE_RANGE"); }
  }
  else if (cmd.startsWith("GEN:")) {
    char g = cmd.charAt(4);
    if (g == 'M' || g == 'F') {
      gender = g;
      lcd.clear();
      lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("Gender set:");
      lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print(gender == 'M' ? "Male" : "Female");
      Serial.println("ACK:GEN:" + String(gender));
      delay(1500);
    } else { Serial.println("ERR:GEN_VALUE"); }
  }
  else if (cmd == "TARE") {
    LoadCell.tare();
    lcd.clear();
    lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("Scale zeroed!");
    lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("OK - Ready!");
    Serial.println("ACK:TARE");
    delay(1500);
  }
  else if (cmd == "MEASURE") {
    if (ageMonths < 0 || gender == '?') {
      Serial.println("ERR:SET_AGE_AND_GENDER_FIRST");
      lcd.clear();
      lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("Set AGE+GENDER");
      lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("via Serial first");
      delay(2000);
    } else { doClassify = true; }
  }
  else if (cmd == "STATUS") {
    Serial.println("STATUS|AGE:" + String(ageMonths) + "|GEN:" + String(gender) + "|W:" + String(weightKg,2) + "|H:" + String(heightCm,1));
  }
}

void classify() {
  float h2SD = getRef(gender=='M' ? BOYS_H2SD  : GIRLS_H2SD,  ageMonths);
  float h3SD = getRef(gender=='M' ? BOYS_H3SD  : GIRLS_H3SD,  ageMonths);
  float w2SD = getRef(gender=='M' ? BOYS_W2SD  : GIRLS_W2SD,  ageMonths);
  float w3SD = getRef(gender=='M' ? BOYS_W3SD  : GIRLS_W3SD,  ageMonths);

  String hStatus; int riskScore;
  if (heightCm <= 0)        { hStatus = "NO DATA";      riskScore = -1; }
  else if (heightCm < h3SD) { hStatus = "SVLY STUNTED"; riskScore = 100; }
  else if (heightCm < h2SD) { hStatus = "STUNTED";      riskScore = calcRiskScore(heightCm, h2SD, h3SD); }
  else                       { hStatus = "NORMAL";       riskScore = 0; }

  String wStatus;
  if (weightKg <= 0)         wStatus = "NO DATA";
  else if (weightKg < w3SD)  wStatus = "SVLY UNDERWT";
  else if (weightKg < w2SD)  wStatus = "UNDERWEIGHT";
  else                        wStatus = "NORMAL WT";

  lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("=== RESULT ===");
  lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print(String(gender)+"/"+String(ageMonths)+"mo"); delay(2000);
  lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("H:"+String(heightCm,1)+"cm");
  lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print(hStatus); delay(3000);
  lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("W:"+String(weightKg,2)+"kg");
  lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print(wStatus); delay(3000);
  if (riskScore >= 0) {
    lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("Risk Score:");
    lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print(String(riskScore)+"/100"); delay(2500);
  }
  if      (riskScore == 100) { lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("!! ALERT !!");    lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("See doctor NOW!"); delay(3000); }
  else if (riskScore >= 40)  { lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("! WARNING !");    lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("Monitor growth");  delay(3000); }
  else if (heightCm > 0 && riskScore == 0) { lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("Height: NORMAL"); lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("Growing well!"); delay(3000); }
  if      (wStatus == "SVLY UNDERWT") { lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("!! WEIGHT !!");   lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("See nutritionist"); delay(3000); }
  else if (wStatus == "UNDERWEIGHT")  { lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("! WEIGHT LOW !"); lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("Improve diet");     delay(3000); }
  else if (wStatus == "NORMAL WT")    { lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("Weight: NORMAL"); lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("Good weight!");    delay(3000); }

  Serial.println("---GROWTHDATA---");
  Serial.print("GENDER:");  Serial.println(gender);
  Serial.print("AGE:");     Serial.println(ageMonths);
  Serial.print("HEIGHT:");  Serial.println(heightCm, 1);
  Serial.print("WEIGHT:");  Serial.println(weightKg, 2);
  Serial.print("HSTATUS:"); Serial.println(hStatus);
  Serial.print("WSTATUS:"); Serial.println(wStatus);
  Serial.print("RISK:");    Serial.println(riskScore);
  Serial.print("H2SD:");    Serial.println(h2SD, 1);
  Serial.print("H3SD:");    Serial.println(h3SD, 1);
  Serial.print("W2SD:");    Serial.println(w2SD, 2);
  Serial.print("W3SD:");    Serial.println(w3SD, 2);
  Serial.println("----------------");
}

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(57600);
  lcd.init(); lcd.backlight();
  pinMode(TRIG_PIN, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(ECHO_PIN, INPUT);
  LoadCell.begin();
  LoadCell.start(2000, true);
  if (LoadCell.getTareTimeoutFlag()) {
    lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("HX711 Error!");
    lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("Check wiring");
    Serial.println("ERR:HX711_TIMEOUT");
    while (1);
  }
  LoadCell.setCalFactor(calibrationValue);
  lcd.clear(); lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("GrowthOracle v2");
  lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("Send AGE+GEN...");
  Serial.println("READY:GrowthOracle_v2");
  Serial.println("INFO:AGE:xx | GEN:M/F | TARE | MEASURE");
  delay(2000);
}

void loop() {
  while (Serial.available()) {
    char c = Serial.read();
    if (c == '\n') { parseSerial(serialBuf); serialBuf = ""; }
    else if (c != '\r') { serialBuf += c; }
  }

  if (LoadCell.update()) {
    float rawGram = LoadCell.getData();
    weightKg = (rawGram < 0) ? 0.0 : rawGram / 1000.0;
    heightCm = measureHeight();

    lcd.clear();
    lcd.setCursor(0,0); lcd.print("W:"); lcd.print(weightKg,2); lcd.print("kg");
    if (ageMonths >= 0 && gender != '?') lcd.print(" "+String(gender)+String(ageMonths));
    lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("H:"); lcd.print(heightCm,1); lcd.print("cm");
    if (ageMonths < 0 || gender == '?') lcd.print(" ?setup");

    Serial.print("RAW|W:"); Serial.print(weightKg,2);
    Serial.print("|H:");    Serial.println(heightCm,1);

    if (doClassify) { doClassify = false; classify(); }
    delay(500);
  }
}
